description: This file defines a controller class `Review` within the Opencart platform's administrative backend. It handles generating scheduled review tasks, listing review data as JSON files, and cleaning up such files. The class extends the core Controller class and interacts with models for tasks, stores, languages, and reviews, utilizing various helper functions for directory and file operations.

classes.name: Review
classes.description: Controller class for managing review-related tasks within the Opencart admin panel, including task generation, review listing, and cleanup.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Generates scheduled review tasks for all stores and languages, dividing products into pages.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Creates a JSON file containing review data for a specific store and language.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Removes generated review JSON files from the filesystem.
